dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian Lim. I can hear you clearly. We can keep the conversation focused. For future telephone appointments, would you prefer that I send a message before calling?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Message first would be better ah. Sometimes I'm out at the warehouse and cannot hear the phone properly. If I'm at my desk, easier to talk. Don't just use my calendar availability; got meetings that move around without anyone updating it.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can send a message to arrange a suitable time rather than rely only on your calendar. You can reply when you are available. Would you prefer that those arrangements come directly to you?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Direct to me can. My staff handle the business appointments, but personal calls I arrange myself. Less confusion like that. Anyway, back to why I called. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund. I want to buy, not sell.

dialogue.text: I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its pooled bond portfolio lets you delegate individual issuer selection rather than research and manage the bond holdings yourself, which matches your preference.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. I am here while you find it, and there is no need to rush through your notes.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Found the page already. For this transaction, use RMB ah. The amount I'm putting into this transaction is 1,000,000. Quantity, put 1,500 units. That's what I've got in my note. Make it a market order, please.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.5%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept losses on this investment?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to bear investment losses. I don't need capital protection. Got another sheet tucked behind this one. Let me get it out; my desk a bit crowded today.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will leave you a moment to finish checking your paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Aiyoh, this is the page I was looking for. Wait ah, I checked my current allocation note. The quantity I gave earlier was wrong; change it to 5,000 units. dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Before we finish, is there anything else about arranging future calls that you would like me to note?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: If I don't reply to the appointment message straight away, don't worry lah. Usually means I'm on the warehouse floor. I'll come back to you when I'm at my desk. No need to ask the office to track me down.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will note that you prefer direct appointment messages and will wait for your reply before arranging a call. Thank you for letting me know about your schedule.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
